svg.aria-label: About me: I build things for the web, and dive deep into AI, data science and design. I'm a Computer Science student from India who thrives on solving complex problems and is always eager to learn new technologies. Right now: building MindNest, building InferaV3, going deeper into AI and ML. Ask me about Python, Data Science, Web Development. Fun fact: with the right logic, any idea can be turned into reality through code.
